text:
olivia: quick flag 0: p99 for /v1/embeddings popped at 2:15 UTC after we flipped routing weights. not sure if real or aggregation artifact.
ben: saw it on the EU shard too. p50 flat, so likely tail. any recent rollup or histogram changes?
tariq: infra PR tweaked rollup window from 15s -> 60s for cost reasons last night. also changed histogram bucket endpoints slightly.
amal: that combination can amplify tdigest_merge tails. does the panel use tdigest_merge?
olivia: yep, dashboard panel uses tdigest_merge over 1m buckets. query pasted in panel notes.
console-bot: Deploy bot: routing-weight-adjustment and rollup-window-change merged by ci/cd at 2024-11-09T02:12Z.
ben: can we replay a recent trace with 15s vs 60s windows to compare? if raw-sample p99 stays same it's an aggregation effect.
tariq: running a quick replay now with bursty small requests. preliminary: merged tdigest at 60s shows a ~400ms higher p99 vs 15s, raw samples stable.
amal: ok that points to aggregation artifact. action items: (1) annotate dashboards where rollup-window changed; (2) add hover provenance showing "source: tdigest_merge(1m)"; (3) put a short note in rollout UI that warns when aggregation config changed within last 1h.
olivia: adding the dashboard annotation now, opening a ticket for provenance hover. ben: I'll add a replay test to CI to catch big diffs when rollup config changes. tariq: will revert the histogram bucket tweak for now to minimize UI drift.
amal: also recommend we add a small explanation in SLO docs about how rollup windows affect display percentiles.
ben: thanks everyone. once revert + annotations live we can mark this resolved. :thumbsup:
